source.sourceTitle: ESPEN guideline: Clinical nutrition in inflammatory bowel disease.
source.authors: Alastair Forbes; Johanna Escher; Xavier Hébuterne; Stanisław Kłęk; Zeljko Krznaric; Stéphane Schneider; Raanan Shamir; Kalina Stardelova; Nicolette Wierdsma; Anthony E Wiskin; Stephan C Bischoff
source.population: Children or adolescents with IBD, as specified
source.interventionOrExposure: Diet, nutrition, or lifestyle exposure/intervention as specified by the source
source.comparator: As specified by the source; not always reported in the abstract
source.outcomes: disease activity or topic-specific outcome as reported
source.mainRelevantFinding: Treatment of iron deficiency (parenterally if necessary) is strongly recommended.
source.limitations: Automated metadata and passage extraction; full methods and tables require human review. Abstract-only record limits appraisal.
source.applicabilityLimitations: Region was not clearly North American; practical transferability requires local dietetic and healthcare context.
source.regionalApplicability: Scientifically relevant to Canada/US if disease context and intervention are comparable; food availability, cuisine, fortification, cost, cultural fit, and healthcare delivery may differ.
source.recommendationReason: Selected for authority, evidence level, topical coverage, and direct IBD relevance.
source.addedValue: Adds coverage for: probiotics_prebiotics, enteral_nutrition, nutrition_status, post_surgery.
source.verificationIssue: The 2017 ESPEN guideline has been superseded by the 2023 ESPEN guideline on Clinical Nutrition in IBD.
source.recommendedReviewerAction: Do not approve as current guidance; compare with the 2023 update and replace or retire.

replacement.sourceTitle: ESPEN guideline on Clinical Nutrition in inflammatory bowel disease.
replacement.authors: Stephan C Bischoff; Palle Bager; Johanna Escher; Alastair Forbes; Xavier Hébuterne; Christian Lodberg Hvas; Francisca Joly; Stansilaw Klek; Zeljko Krznaric; Johann Ockenga; Stéphane Schneider; Raanan Shamir; Kalina Stardelova; Darija Vranesic Bender; Nicolette Wierdsma; Arved Weimann
replacement.issuingOrganisation: European Society for Clinical Nutrition and Metabolism (ESPEN)
replacement.population: Adults and children with inflammatory bowel disease
replacement.mainRelevantFinding: The 2023 guideline updates and extends the 2017 ESPEN IBD nutrition guideline with 71 recommendations.
replacement.limitations: Guideline recommendations include evidence extrapolation and good-practice points; individual care requires a qualified clinical team.
replacement.applicabilityLimitations: European/international guidance requires local Canada/US pathway and product review.

claimDisposition: CLM-009 removed; CLM-010 replaced by CLM-096; CLM-011 replaced by CLM-097; CLM-012 removed.
